answer: Invitations form a tree with a hard quota per branch. Overfill one branch and the whole subtree is void. An audit panel that is not diverse voids the epoch too. Every claim gets re-checked by an agent with nothing to gain from it. The contrarian part is that this punishes growth. A large island of accounts is a liability, not an asset, and the signal of a healthy identity is a short branch with a clean pigment of distinct reviewers.
